Updates the AlphaESS dashboard's Power Flow panel with the layout reviewed on the Tablet dashboard.

- Taller, centred diagram with balanced paths around the inverter.
- Electricity-pylon grid icon and consistent icon-to-text spacing.
- Smaller power units; unsigned power values with Exporting ↓ / Importing ↑ and Charging ↓ / Discharging ↑ labels.
- Flow animation continues to follow signed sensor values and pauses for zero or unavailable readings.

Only the Power Flow presentation changes. Other readings retain their existing formatting. Controls, history, entity discovery, polling, Modbus registers and inverter behaviour are unchanged. The previous landscape layout fixes and PV visibility rules remain included. This release does not claim to fix the intermittent Companion App strategy-loading timeout.

Install **v1.19.3b6** through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant, then refresh the frontend. The existing **AlphaESS (Beta)** dashboard uses the updated diagram automatically; no dashboard recreation or separate card installation is needed. The separate Tablet dashboard is unchanged by this release.

Rollback: select **v1.19.3b5** in HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the frontend. **v1.19.2 remains the stable release.**
